theme_strategy: Dual Theme (Light & Dark). Light theme represents daytime academic rigor (ink-and-parchment). Dark theme represents cosmic/ritualistic depth (Shloka recitation, Sadhana, Night studies).

fonts.usage: Latin Headings (H1-H3). Conveys university-grade academic rigor and elegant editorial feel. Never use Inter/Roboto.
Latin Body text, UI labels, small caps overlines. Clean, humanist sans-serif that balances the traditional serif, offering the 'streaming site' accessibility.
Primary Devanagari text (Shlokas, Mantras). Exquisite, traditional serif designed specifically for Sanskrit typographic rigor.
Fallback/UI Devanagari where Tiro is too stylistic.

hierarchy.shloka_main: text-4xl md:text-5xl font-devanagari leading-relaxed tracking-wide text-primary

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle SVG noise filter overlay (opacity 2-3%) across the entire background to simulate ancient parchment/vellum feel, removing pure digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Crystal Glass variant (high blur backdrop-blur-2xl, saturated background, 1px bright inner border) specifically reserved for the Shloka Player floating controls and Sticky Navigations.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders using muted tones. Avoid thick borders. Soft internal glowing borders on active elements.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for Light mode. Dark mode relies on 1px subtle borders (border-white/10) instead of shadows.

grids_and_layouts.philosophy: Generous whitespace (p-12 to p-24), left-aligned asymmetry. Avoid center-everything designs.
grids_and_layouts.course_discovery: Bento Grid (Mode A). Spans varying from col-span-4 to col-span-8. Some cards feature massive typography, others rich imagery. Never perfect uniform rows.
grids_and_layouts.admin_portals: High Density Grid (Mode B). Tighter gaps, strictly utilitarian, leveraging monochrome hierarchy with clear functional color coding.
grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24. Containers must have internal padding (p-8) to prevent text collision.

shloka_player.concept: The Jewel of the platform. A cinematic, immersive experience.
shloka_player.layout: Asymmetric overlay. Left side: Massive Devanagari verse (Tiro Devanagari Sanskrit) with IAST transliteration below it. Right side: Grammatical breakdown and attributed commentary.
shloka_player.interactions: Hovering over a Devanagari word highlights the exact IAST and English translation simultaneously (Word-by-word grammar map).
shloka_player.audio_controls: Floating crystal glass bar at the bottom. Play/Pause, Speed Control, 'Record Yourself' button with terracotta glowing state, delicate audio waveform visualizer.

sadhana_daily_view.concept: Ritual, not a dashboard. Meditative, distraction-free.
sadhana_daily_view.layout: Centered concentric circles forming a large 'Japa Counter' that users tap. Surrounding space is highly negative (empty).
sadhana_daily_view.streak_system: Compassionate design: missed days are shown as fading/dimmed dots in a lunar phase arc, rather than a broken chain or red '0'.
sadhana_daily_view.typography: Sankalpa (vow) text displayed in elegant serif italics.

course_discovery_grid.concept: University catalog meets modern streaming site.
course_discovery_grid.layout: Asymmetric masonry/bento grid. Use high-contrast imagery overlaid with heavy gradients for text readability. Badges for 'Credentialed' or 'Live Session'.
course_discovery_grid.interactions: Hover states scale the image subtly (1.05) and reveal course syllabus preview.

calculators_panchang_kundli.layout: Dense but highly legible data tables. Linear, border-bottom focused inputs (no heavy boxes). Output graphs (Kundli) rendered with crisp SVG geometry, neutral tones.
calculators_panchang_kundli.forms: Step-by-step wizard style to prevent cognitive overload. Generous padding.

pathway_consultation_form.layout: Split screen. Left: Editorial photo of an Acharya + Trust markers. Right: Minimalist form (Name, Email, Phone, Consent) with a warm terracotta CTA button.

acharya_profile.layout: Editorial layout. Large portrait. A 'Lineage Tree' visual component. List of credentials and sign-offs on courses.
acharya_profile.typography: Heavy reliance on Serif for their quotes/teaching philosophy.

admin_capability_matrix.layout: Dense data table (Shadcn Table) with sticky headers. Rows = Staff, Columns = Capabilities (Course Builder, Grader, Doubts). Boolean toggle switches (Neumorphic tactile variant).

motion_and_interactions.transitions: Longer durations (0.4s to 0.6s) with ease-out-expo for page elements. Avoid bouncy springs. Use smooth fades and gentle vertical drifts.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Text colors gently transition, borders glow. Avoid harsh scaling except for hero/course cards (max 1.05 scale).
motion_and_interactions.shloka_sync: Highlighting words during audio playback should crossfade smoothly, feeling like a glowing ember moving through the text.

media.usage_instructions: Images should primarily be used as ambient backgrounds with heavy contrast overlays (bg-black/40 to bg-black/60) to allow text to breathe, or cropped as sharp geometric assets in Bento grids.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast compliance. All small text must have minimum 4.5:1 contrast. Use pure primary color strictly for CTAs to avoid dilution.
accessibility.typography: Devanagari text MUST have increased line-height (leading-loose or leading-[1.8]) and larger base sizes (text-lg minimum) to accommodate complex conjuncts (samyuktakshara) and matras.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements, forms, counters, and shloka interactions MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Generate .js files, NOT .tsx files. Use standard React + JS syntax.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use absolute transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, overlays, or sticky headers. Always use Solid or Glassmorphism backgrounds.
Use Lucide-react for UI icons. Use Phosphor Icons for dense Admin portals if needed.
Ensure 'Cormorant Garamond', 'Manrope', and 'Tiro Devanagari Sanskrit' are imported from Google Fonts in the root HTML/CSS.
Do NOT use default Inter, Roboto, or Poppins anywhere.
Implement the Dual Theme (Light/Dark) toggle globally, defaulting to Light mode for the main site, but allowing Shloka Player to force Dark mode for immersion if desired.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Do not use simplistic center-everything layouts. Create depth through layered design and z-index hierarchy.
Do not use universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform) to prevent transform breakage.
Do NOT add '.App { text-align: center; }' to global CSS. Align text to the left by default to respect reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with explicit hover/focus states.
NEVER use emojis (🤖🧠💭) as UI icons.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='shloka-play-btn').
